_readme: This is a TEMPLATE for seeding verified government office data.
Do NOT ship invented offices. Collect each record from an official
- NID / voter registration: Election Commission (ecs.gov.bd / services.nidw.gov.bd)
- Birth registration: BDRIS (bdris.gov.bd) / Office of the Registrar General
For every record record the address, coordinates (from the official
map/office locator), a phone number ONLY if published by the office,
the source URL and the date you verified it (lastVerifiedAt).
Then run: npm run seed:offices -- path/to/this-file.json
Delete every field starting with '_' before using, and replace the
PLACEHOLDER values below (or delete the sample entry entirely).

offices.name: PLACEHOLDER — replace with the verified office name
offices.address: PLACEHOLDER — replace with the verified address
